findings: Push triggers are restricted to the intended research branch and the workflow/request paths; the first-attempt, expected-parent, exact-event-after and branch guards precede installation and execution.
Read-only repository/actions permissions and persist-credentials:false match this build/replay-only job. Checkout/upload/download action revisions are pinned.

The request, root gate and corrected driver agree on the single producer-controls, producer-preparation, independent-controls and independent-replay calls. The workflow calls the driver once and provides no retry, native query or second preparation path.

All 42 unique gate dependencies are hashed with byte counts, and every configured input/source/proof/review has a matching dependency. The exact 45-path sparse checkout covers these dependencies, the workflow, gate and request.
The worker/runtime installation pins OR-Tools 9.15.6755 and protobuf 6.33.6. Python files are compiled before the driver; compilation is future CI work, not performed by this review.

Preparation, controls, replay, replay controls and both external owner directories are distinct and match the request and artifact exports. Driver acceptance requires reaped/stopped ownership and full model/count/preservation comparisons.

The always-run primary export preserves exact file bytes, including owners, failures, parameters where present, ledger, suffix and restoration metadata. It excludes only the duplicate full model files from its compact bundle; the full artifact retains the model.

The full model archive is exported separately through three read-only jobs with four-MiB chunks and complete archive/part byte and SHA bindings. An empty final chunk is allowed. The archive is capped at twelve MiB.
Primary bundle caps are sixteen MiB raw files and twelve MiB encoded. Full artifact retention is thirty days. The outer production job is bounded at twelve minutes.
limitations: This review checks complete frozen workflow wiring and declared input identities. It does not claim that the future CI build, independent replay or artifact export has executed successfully.
The underlying producer, checker and mathematical authorities retain their separate frozen source reviews; this record does not replace their actual terminal receipts.
